findings.title: Exercise board-origin emergence and return in presenter tests
findings.why_it_matters: A regression that makes combatants emerge from the wrong squares or return to a stale square after rotation would pass the current automated assertions. Every presenter unit test omits origins, so neither new board-origin lifecycle branch runs; its tween mock also never executes onUpdate. The browser tests check phase completion, canvas sizing and background visibility, but never assert the actors' square-relative emergence or return positions. Supplying a changing origins callback and advancing observable actor movement would protect the board connection that this change introduces.
findings.validation_reason: The diff adds board-origin emergence and dynamic return at FirewormPresenter.ts:67-72 and 94-101, reachable through AttackScene.ts:164-165 for non-reduced board captures, but every presenter test omits origins and its tween stub never calls onUpdate (fireworm_presenter.test.ts:29,39,50,62,75,77), while the inspected browser tests assert phases, completion and background pixels without actor positions, leaving the required board-square movement and resize-dependent destination unverified.
